definitions.short: Assir , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H617. Assir אַסִּיר proper name, masculine son of Korah Exod 6:24 ; 1Chr 6:7 ; called son of Ebiasaph v. 6:8 ; v. 6:22 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Korah: Assir, and Elkanah, and Abiasaph; these are the families of the Korahites.
The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,
Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.
Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.
The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
